name: Freesound
description: Large community sound-effects catalogue with per-sound Creative Commons licensing. Useful for prototyping and production audio discovery only when commercial-compatible licences are filtered and exact-sound provenance is preserved.

licence.identifier: Mixed per-sound Creative Commons licences (CC0, CC-BY, CC-BY-NC and legacy licences)
licence.notice: Commercial By JTT projects must exclude CC-BY-NC/non-commercial sounds and preserve exact licence/attribution for each adopted sound. Prefer CC0 or clearly compatible CC-BY entries when quality is equivalent.

provenance.notes: Community uploads have explicit per-sound licences, but exact recording/source/rightsholder confidence must be assessed per adopted sound.

maintenance.evidence: Official Freesound FAQ documents the current per-sound licence model.
maintenance.notes: Qualification is as a discovery surface only; no sound inherits catalogue-level approval.

compatibility.notes: Technical suitability depends on exact download format, quality, loudness, loop quality, compression and runtime memory/streaming requirements.

risk.legalNotes: CC-BY-NC is unsuitable for commercial releases. Exact sound licence, author, source and attribution must be retained. Do not assume user upload guarantees all underlying rights.
risk.securityNotes: Community-hosted downloadable files; validate media and conversion pipeline before import.

assessment.notes: Useful audio discovery source when automation filters commercial-compatible licences and exact sounds pass provenance/quality review.

evidence.notes: Official FAQ documents CC0, attribution and attribution-noncommercial licence options and states use depends on the selected sound's licence.

publication.notes: Public page must clearly warn that not all Freesound content is commercially reusable and that exact-sound licence filtering is mandatory.
